concerns.text: FR-001 references “US-1” (see line “System MUST connect to the OpenML API () … (See US-1)”), but the specification only defines “User Story 1” – there is no identifier US-1 defined elsewhere.
FR-006 cites “US-3” as the source for an A‑Priori Power Analysis capability, yet US‑3 in the document describes computing observed power, not a priori analysis. The cross‑reference is mismatched.
The OpenML API call in FR-001 contains empty parentheses “OpenML API ()”, omitting the URL or endpoint that should be specified.
Inconsistent terminology: the narrative uses “User Story 1/2/3” while functional requirements refer to “US‑1/US‑2/US‑3”. This creates ambiguous cross‑references and may confuse traceability.
